FX_GlowSoft.use: every round glow quad: SpaceKit.Glow (sun parts, glints, engine glows, running lights, capsule heads)

FX_BeamSoft.use: LineRenderer texture (Texture Mode Tile or Stretch): U along the line (tiles seamlessly), V across
FX_BeamSoft.replaces: SpaceKit.SoftBand (UI/Cutscene/SpaceKit.cs:105-113) via SpaceKit.Line: SurveySet scan/echo and meridians (SurveySet.cs:59-68)

FX_SunCore.use: the sun disc quad (scale = SpaceStyle.SunSize); disc fills 34 % of the quad radius, corona to 75 %

FX_SunHalo.use: the halo quad around the sun (scale = SpaceStyle.HaloSize); faint fine rays and a limb shoulder

FX_SunStreak.use: anamorphic flare across the sun (quad scaled StreakLength x StreakLength * StreakThickness)

FX_Glint.use: crystal glints on the survey planet; four long spikes, four short diagonals

FX_EngineGlow.use: engine exhaust glow on the mothership nozzles (camera-facing): hot core, lit nozzle ring, shock rings

FX_ExhaustPlume.use: optional stretched quad / particle behind a nozzle (nozzle at the top edge, V down the plume); for a plume aligned with the ship's back axis
FX_ExhaustPlume.replaces: new (OrbitSet.cs:189 exhaust, if a directional plume is added)

FX_RunningLight.use: blinking navigation lights on the mothership: tight dot with a tiny cross

FX_PlasmaTrail.use: re-entry plasma trail, LineRenderer Texture Mode Stretch: U = 0 at the capsule (head), 1 at the tail; keep the gradient/width curves
FX_PlasmaTrail.replaces: default particle texture on the FieldSet capsule streak (FieldSet.cs:412-424) and SoftBand on the CapsuleDrop trails (CapsuleDrop.cs:179-182)

FX_DrillCracks.use: ground decal under the drill, 2 x 2 sheet (512 px cells, top-left first): radial glowing cracks from the bore hole. One quad of radius ~2.6 m with _BaseMap tiling (0.5, 0.5) and offset per cell; grow its scale with `open`
FX_DrillCracks.replaces: the 6 stretched GlowDecal.Radial crack quads in FieldDrill (FieldDrill.cs:75-84, posed at FieldDrill.cs:127-134)

FX_CrackStrip_Drill_A.use: one straight crack per quad, centred, tapering to both ends (scale x = width, y = length)
FX_CrackStrip_Drill_A.replaces: GlowDecal.Radial on the FieldDrill crack quads (FieldDrill.cs:76-84) if the 6-quad rig is kept

FX_CrackStrip_Drill_B.use: one straight crack per quad, centred, tapering to both ends (scale x = width, y = length)
FX_CrackStrip_Drill_B.replaces: GlowDecal.Radial on the FieldDrill crack quads (FieldDrill.cs:76-84) if the 6-quad rig is kept

FX_CrackStrip_Swarm_A.use: a ground fissure that opens: molten lens mid-length, crust edges (scale x = width, y = length)
FX_CrackStrip_Swarm_A.replaces: GlowDecal.Radial on the FieldSwarm crack decals (FieldSwarm.cs:69, BuildCracks 164-176, posed 90-98)

FX_CrackStrip_Swarm_B.use: a ground fissure that opens: molten lens mid-length, crust edges (scale x = width, y = length)
FX_CrackStrip_Swarm_B.replaces: GlowDecal.Radial on the FieldSwarm crack decals (FieldSwarm.cs:69, BuildCracks 164-176, posed 90-98)

FX_ScreamRing.use: expanding shock ring of the scream (ground decal, scale = radius * 2): sharp leading edge at 90 % of the quad radius, ripples and a fading wake inside
FX_ScreamRing.replaces: GlowDecal.Radial on ScreamRing (FieldSwarm.cs:70, Decal at 282-293, posed at 112-114)

FX_GateField.use: gate energy sheets: U across the field (built-in edge fade and bright rims), V tiles seamlessly (scroll it like the old scanlines); 6 scanlines, 4 hex rows and vertical shimmer per tile
FX_GateField.replaces: GlowDecal.Scanlines via GlowDecal.ScanlineMaterial on the FieldBase gate sheets (FieldBase.cs:389-392, Sheet 395-406, posed via _gateFields; also FieldBase.cs:483)

_notes.convention: PNG row 0 = top (Unity v = 1). Greyscale RGBA with RGB = A; tint with the existing HDR colours. Low/ = half size.
